## About
Alameda Auto Body and Services is the collision shop on Everett Street. Our mission is simple: excellent automotive repair service for each and every one of our customers.
We do body repairs, frame repair, sheet metal and welding, and automotive painting with computerized color-matching right here in the shop. We also coordinate wheel alignment and suspension repair when a collision calls for it.
We've built our reputation on quality, honesty, and value, and it shows in a 4.7 rating from 296 Google reviews. One customer told us we've taken care of her for decades. That's the kind of shop we want to be for the neighborhood.

## Services
- Collision-related body repairs: Dents, damaged panels and body work after an accident, done in-house.
- Collision-related frame repair: Frame work after a collision, handled in our own shop.
- Automotive painting with computerized color-matching: Paint that matches the rest of your car.
- Sheet metal and welding work: Metal repair and welding done in-house.
- Windshield chip repair: Fixing chips in your windshield.
- Collision-related wheel alignment: Alignment after a collision, which we facilitate for you.
- Collision-related suspension repair: Suspension repair after a collision, which we facilitate for you.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We have experience working with insurance companies of all sizes to get you back on the road as quickly and safely as possible.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover.

Q: How do I book an appointment or check on my repair?
A: You can schedule an online appointment with us on carwise.com, and you can check your repair status there too. Or just call the shop.
